claim: Gen Z weekly Bible reading rose from 30% (2024) to 49% (2025); millennials rose 16 points to 50%; all US adults reached 42%; young men lead.
excerpt: Summary from Barna and partner pages: weekly Bible reading rebounded 12 points from a 15-year low; younger men now outpace younger women.
title: How Millennials and Gen Z Are Driving a Bible Reading Comeback
